title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Peter Martyr (Calvin/Bucer) mine; sin in Adam by communion, not singular imputation
pass_a_gloss: That you say Peter Martyr (who followed Calvin and Bucer and is wholly mine) and others granted that all sinned in Adam does not hurt Placeus: he cries that all sin in Adam as they die in Adam—by the force of communion with Adam, not by imputation of Adam’s singular sin or death.
pass_b_english: That you say Peter Martyr (who followed the steps of Calvin and Bucer and is wholly mine) and the others acknowledged that all men sinned in Adam does not hurt me.
I cry that all men sin in Adam as they die in Adam—that is, by the force of the communion they have with Adam, not by imputation of his singular sin or of his death.
source_text: Quod Petrum Martyrem (qui Calvini & Buceri vestigia secutus totus meus est) ac caeteros dicis agnovisse, omnes homines in Adamo peccasse, mihi non obest, qui clamo omnes homines peccare in Adamo quomodo in Adamo moriuntur, hoc est, vi communionis quam habent cum Adamo, non autem imputatione singularis eius vel peccati, vel mortis.

choices.choice: Sin/die in Adam by communion, not singular imputation
